info.title: DermaCare AI API Reference
info.description:
# DermaCare AI — Implemented REST API

This document contains only operations mounted by the current Express application. Proposal-era contracts are excluded from active paths and retained separately in inventory metadata.

### Key Scope & Architecture:
- **AI Skin Screening**: Image analysis, differential findings, confidence calibration, and emergency red-flag safeguards.
- **Doctor Discovery & Booking**: Verified dermatologists, condition matching, atomic 10-minute slot holds, and scheduling.
- **Telemedicine & Consultations**: Consent-gated clinical records, time-limited Jitsi video, and SOAP note authoring.
- **Prescriptions & Digital Pharmacy**: Immutable prescription versioning, generic matching, and Rx-verified ordering.
- **Post-Consultation Chat**: Secure 7-day text messaging channel between patient and treating physician.
- **Sandbox Financials**: Simulated payments, subscription tiers (Free, Patient Premium, Doctor Featured), and order fulfillment.

---

### Non-Negotiable Healthcare Safety Rules:
1. **Preliminary AI Advisory**: AI screening results are strictly preliminary. Confidence below 60% suppresses OTC recommendations; high-risk scores above 20% trigger clinical urgency warnings; red flags override all outputs.
2. **Strict RBAC & Consent**: Never trust client-supplied `role` or `userId`. Pre-consultation patient records are accessible ONLY to the booked doctor after explicit patient consent.
3. **Atomic Slot Reservation**: Slot holds last exactly 10 minutes to eliminate double-booking.
4. **Prescription Immutability**: Finalizing a prescription freezes that legal version. Amendments create new versions.
5. **Separation of Sponsored Content**: Advertisements must be labeled "Sponsored" and MUST NEVER appear on AI results, emergency alerts, consultations, prescriptions, or chats.

---
> **Implementation Status:** 64 mounted operations are documented. Proposal-era operations are not advertised as callable APIs.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: **Module 01** — Patient and doctor registration, email OTP verification, JWT access/refresh token lifecycle, and secure identity recovery.

tags.name: Unified Profiles
tags.description: **Module 02** — Role-specific profile management for patients and doctors, medical history summaries, and clinical license verification submissions.

tags.name: AI Screening & Conditions
tags.description: **Module 03** — Dermatological AI image and symptom screening, preliminary risk calculation, confidence scoring, and condition encyclopedia reference.

tags.name: Doctor Discovery
tags.description: **Module 04** — Specialist search, filtering by verified credentials, condition-based matching via screeningId, and public slot inspection.

tags.name: Booking & Availability
tags.description: **Module 05** — Doctor slot schedule management, atomic 10-minute temporary holds, booking confirmation with patient consent, and cancellation workflows.

tags.name: Consultation
tags.description: **Module 06** — Consent-gated clinical history access, time-limited Jitsi telemedicine video sessions, consultation state transitions, and clinical note authoring.

tags.name: Prescriptions & Medication
tags.description: **Module 07** — Doctor prescription authoring, atomic draft medication item replacement, immutable version finalization, and derived medication tracking.

tags.name: Post-consultation Chat
tags.description: **Module 08** — Time-windowed post-consultation secure text messaging between the verified patient and the assigned doctor.

tags.name: Store & Orders
tags.description: **Module 09** — Fictional dermatological medicine catalog, generic alternatives matching, cart management with Rx verification, and order placement.

tags.name: Sandbox Payments
tags.description: **Module 10** — Sandbox payment transaction creation for bookings, medicine orders, and subscription tiers, with server-controlled demo simulation.

tags.name: Admin Operations
tags.description: **Module 11** — Administrative user governance, doctor license verification and approval, catalog management, and order fulfillment workflows.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: **Module 12** — In-app clinical and transactional notification inbox, unread count polling, and read state synchronization.

tags.name: Health & Secure Images
tags.description: **Module 13** — System health liveness probe and secure, time-limited presigned URL generation for private medical imagery.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: **Module 14** — Patient premium tier and doctor featured visibility subscription plans, sandbox checkout, usage tracking, and quota enforcement.

tags.name: Sponsored Content
tags.description: **Module 15** — Placement-targeted healthcare product sponsorships, campaign scheduling, and administrative ad moderation.

tags.name: Advanced Analytics
tags.description: **Module 16** — Aggregated administrative metrics, time-series operational trends, fictional sandbox revenue reporting, and clinical audit logging.
